what: The camera flies in depth from a screen-pinned section — photo panels and big text panels stand at data-z (-450·-950·-1350px …) depths, with a full-bleed photo (-2000px) at the very back. While scrolling through the section, the world is pulled forward by (1 − (1 − a)²) × 2000px (a = progress / .765, narrow screen .52 — a curve that slows outward), a panel that has passed the camera disappears within 180px and the rearmost photo fills the screen. From .74 (narrow screen .49) the name stands up from 28px below over .07. On devices with a pointer the world tilts toward the cursor by ±1.25° horizontal and ∓.9° vertical, following over 1.2s power2.out (only when the section fully covers the screen)

options.title-at · title-at-narrow · title-span: Progress where the name starts to appear · share it takes · rise distance, default .74 · .49 · .07 · 28
options.fade: Distance at which the passed panel disappears (px), default 180
options.[data-fx-part=pin] · [data-fx-part=world: Panel pinned to the screen and the 3D world inside it
options.[data-z] · [data-fx-part=hero] · [data-f: Depth plate (px) · full back plate · name that stands last
options.--fx-height · --fx-height-narrow · --fx-: (css variable) section height 340vh · narrow screen 200vh · perspective 1100px
